notes: *what … soever* is one discontinuous unit on כֹּל plus אֲשֶׁר (rules 25, 30, 35), wrapped around the noun the ASV writes between them.
The resumptive suffix on עָלָיו is unrepresented under rule 22's first sentence, since the ASV writes a bare *upon* and no pronominal adverb carries the resumption.
